text:
mara_infra: FYI — gpool-prod-3 is down to 6/8 H100s after the weekend swap. Two units marked DOA at the depot, vendor says split shipment + customs hold. This is impacting our nightly batch jobs (latency spikes) and causing autoscaler backpressure.

leo_ops: ugh. which depot/waybill? can we get loaner units or temporary re-route from eu-pool? :thinking_face:

mara_infra: Waybill & depot per vendor below, they flagged a customs classification mismatch. No loaners promised yet. cluster impact: 20% less throughput on gen-2 workloads, queueing rebuilds.

sam_accellog: Apologies — we see two units flagged DOA on intake at FRA crossdock. Carrier held due to HS code discrepancy. AWB: ABX-987654321. Carrier: AirBridgeX. ETA hold status: customs query open.

cass_sourcing: @sam_accellog we need an immediate credit and expedited replacement plan. Can you confirm if replacements are available from your EU pool or if we get a temporary loaner manifest? Also need damage photos and serials for warranty.

sam_accellog: Replacements: we have 3 H100s in DE pool but shipping options vary. We can send 2 units via next-flight express (expedite surcharge applies) or standard consolidated (5–7d). We can issue a provisional credit for the depot DOA after we confirm root cause. Photos/serials attached in email thread (sent to cass).

leo_ops: For immediate mitigation, can infra schedule redispatch of lower-priority jobs to other regions? We can re-balance to us-west and ap-south for non-PII workloads to free capacity for critical queues. Will need ETA on express loaners to decide.

mara_infra: Yes — can throttle noncritical batched gen tasks. Investing that compute elsewhere adds ~2.5hr to completion but avoids SLO breaches. We need express ETA before 09:00 UTC tomorrow to decide on a canary swap during nightly window.

sam_accellog: Express ETA if cleared today: 24–36h. If customs issue persists, we recommend rerouting AWB to FRA direct import with HS code 8473.30 (per our customs broker) — that should clear. If you want, we can create a reconsignment instruction now.

cass_sourcing: Cost question: what's the surcharge for express vs credit? Also we need an RMA flow confirmed — will you pick up DOA units or do we return to vendor depot? Contract says vendor to handle return shipping for DOA within warranty, but customs/forwarder fees might be on us unless vendor admits classification error.

sam_accellog: Express surcharge estimate: $9k per unit door-to-door from DE->US (includes premium handling). Provisional credit: up to 70% of unit value pending inspection. Return logistics: we can arrange depot pickup but need commercial invoice corrections for customs. If classification error is on vendor side, vendor will cover broker fees. We're initiating broker appeal now.

alexa_shipping_bot: Update: AWB ABX-987654321 moved to HOLD - FRA customs. Broker ticket #CB-2219 opened. Docs requested: commercial invoice with revised HS, photos, serials. Link: https://carrier.example/track/ABX-987654321

leo_ops: OK — assume worst-case customs delay 72h. Mara, start throttles now and open a temporary canary to move critical jobs to us-west tonight. Cass, negotiate to waive broker fees if classification error proved. Sam — pls confirm if they can pre-advise express manifest so we can book swap window.

cass_sourcing: On it. I'll push for fee waiver and request express manifest + provisional loaner hold. Also asking for SKU-level replacement vs refurbished — we need new units for prod.

sam_accellog: Noted. I'll request new-unit replacement and put a hold on refurbished allocations. Will share manifest and tracking once reconsignment is filed. Expect docs in 2–4h.

mara_infra: Thanks. Action items: (1) leo_ops throttle noncritical jobs (started), (2) cass push waiver + manifest (in flight), (3) sam provide manifest/tracking + confirm loaner ETA (in flight). If vendor can't cover broker fees, finance/ops will need cost approval — tag @finance later.

leo_ops: We should also add a short-term alert on Console per-route showing degraded throughput so product teams aren't surprised. I'll add a banner and pin the incident thread.

cass_sourcing: Filing negotiation note: request full broker fee waiver + overnight air at vendor expense if classification error confirmed; else split 50/50 on broker fees. Will push for exclusion of refurbished replacements.

sam_accellog: Understood. I'll escalate to logistics lead and customs broker now. Will ping when reconsignment filed.

mara_infra: Great — please update thread when AWB moves. If express manifest comes through, we'll schedule swap 02:00–04:00 UTC tomorrow.

alexa_shipping_bot: Broker ticket updated CB-2219 -> evidence requested queued. Next update ETA 4h.

cass_sourcing: adding final note — if express is >$15k total we should route budget through emergency procurement approval. I'll prepare estimate and CC @finance.

sam_accellog: manifest draft attached, reconsignment requested to FRA import. Will share final AWB and expected flight once broker clears.

mara_infra: thanks team. keeping infra on standby for swap. :thumbsup:
